question: If the ratio of radius and height of a cylinder is 3 ∶ 2 and radius is 21 cm, then find the curved surface area (in cm²). (use π = 22/7)
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the radius and height of the cylinder = 3: 2

Radius = 21 cm

Formula used:

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

Here,

r = radius

h = height

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44bdd8cc86a51c6f1552e2e6acc3e991d337017512b65cf94c2911eda8c27424.png] 

Let the radius of the base and height of the cylinder be 3x and 2x

So,

3x → 21

2x → 21/3 × 2 = 14

Curved surface area = 2π × 21 × 14

 

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 14

⇒ 2 × 22 × 21 × 2

⇒ 1848

∴ The curved surface area (in cm2) of the cylinder is 1848.
